questions.stem: Which of the following drugs is not used in typhoid fever?
questions.solutionHtml:
Amikacin
  • Amikacin is an antibiotic used to prevent or treat a wide variety of bacterial infections. These may include infections of the urinary tract, bones, and joints, lungs (eg. pneumonia), brain, blood, among others. It is also used in hospitalized patients to prevent infections.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not an adverse effect of salbutamol?
Which of the following drug is commonly used in OPD for community acquired pneumonia caused by S. aureus?
questions.solutionHtml:
Azithromycin

This question requires more of common sense than the actual science: Here we have only one drug which is active orally i.e. Azithromycin. Rest all-drugs, i.e., vancomycin (given orally only for one condition, i.e., antibiotic-associated diarrhea), ceftriaxone and streptomycin are used by parenteral route. We require OPO based treatment; hence Azithromycin is the best answer here.
